about: Yaarbro's rope clips, made by tools/meshy-rig-animate.mjs from Meshy's animation library (14 credits: the rig and three clips). rope_catch is the jump up and catch from 'Jump and Hang on Bar' (the reach and the catch are cut from it in tools/yaarbro.guide.json); rope_hang is 'Rope Hang Idle', both hands on the rope; rope_release is the swing and let go from 'Swing on Rope to Ground'.
